# NOTICE

## AI-generated assets

All 55 models, their baked textures, and the 13 skeletons in this repository were
**generated by an AI image-to-3D pipeline** and post-processed with Blender
5.0.

- Meshes: AI-generated geometry, decimated and re-normalised
- Textures: AI-baked albedo / normal / metallic-roughness maps, packed per model
- Rigs: procedurally generated 20-bone humanoid skeletons with heat-diffuse
  vertex weighting
- Animation: **none** — rigs ship un-animated on purpose

No asset here is derived from, traced from, or copied out of any existing game,
film, animation, or commercial product. The repository name, category names and
file names were chosen by the author when assembling the pack.

## A note for commercial use

The MIT license in [`LICENSE`](LICENSE) grants you broad rights, including
commercial use. It cannot, however, warrant that the output of a generative model
is free of third-party influence.

Before shipping any of these assets inside a commercial product, review the ones
you intend to use. Generative 3D models can occasionally carry shapes, surface
patterns or silhouettes that resemble well-known characters or brands. That risk
sits with you as the publisher, so a quick visual check is worth the time.

## Third-party software

- Exported and processed with [Blender](https://www.blender.org) 5.0 (GPL).
  The exported `.blend` and `.glb` files in this repository are outputs of that
  tool, not copies of it.
- File format: [glTF 2.0](https://www.khronos.org/gltf/) (Khronos, permissive spec).
